# Material menu icons

Google Material Design Icons, Apache-2.0; fixed commit `10ecc14790612ca8fd164e3f4ffe9c16fc50d5b7`.

Source paths: `src/<category>/<name>/materialiconsoutlined/24px.svg`. Transparent SVG paths are omitted; visible paths are preserved in 24×24 VectorDrawable resources. Full license: `../../app/src/main/res/raw/material_icons_license.txt`.
